name: TradeFlow

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 mention on website; site claims 'maximum data security' with no certification, no trust/security page
Sells AI trade-settlement software to financial firms' back offices (Goldman-alum founder), a buyer segment that requires SOC 2 in vendor reviews

pitch_note: Fintech settlement startup selling into institutional finance back offices with no SOC 2 badge anywhere -- they will hit vendor-security walls fast. Weak spots: only 2 people, not hiring, and no funding beyond the YC standard deal, so budget/urgency is unproven.

name: Elayne

soc2_evidence.signal: Third-party review profile reports 'bank-level encryption, SOC II certification, HIPAA compliance, MFA' -- suggests SOC 2 already obtained or claimed
Elayne's own homepage claims only 'bank-level security' with encryption; no SOC 2 badge or trust page, and elayne.com/security returns 404

pitch_note: Third-party profiles report Elayne already holds SOC II certification (unverified on their own site), which likely means the Type I work is done or well underway. Hiring and Accel-backed, so worth a light touch for Type II/renewal services, but not a fresh Type I prospect.

name: Usul

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 certification or trust page found on usul.com; site says 'secure, trusted way to deploy AI' with no framework named
Sells AI platform to defense contractors and government-facing teams -- buyers with heavy compliance expectations (SOC 2/CMMC/FedRAMP pressure)

pitch_note: 15-person, $3.3M-seeded defense/gov AI platform with paying defense primes and zero public SOC 2 posture -- exactly the profile that gets forced into SOC 2 (and beyond) by contractor procurement. Actively hiring engineering and GTM, so security questionnaires are landing on their desk now.

name: SimCare

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2, HIPAA, or FERPA mention on site or docs; no trust center found
Sells B2B to medical schools, social work programs, and behavioral-health training buyers -- institutional buyers that run vendor security reviews

hiring_signals: Founding Operations Associate ($80K-$100K, NYC) -- no engineering/security roles open
pitch_note: Seed-funded ($2M, Drive Capital) healthcare-training AI selling to med schools and health programs with no compliance posture published -- university and health-system procurement will demand SOC 2/HIPAA answers as they scale past $5M ARR targets. Slight ding: education buyers push less hard than payers, and no infra hiring signal.

name: EffiGov

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 or compliance framework found on site or job posts
Sells AI call-taking to city/county governments (live in a 160K-resident county) -- gov procurement routinely requires SOC 2 and security attestations

hiring_signals: Founding Engineer ($100K-$200K, 0.60%-3.00% equity, SF) -- owns full stack including AWS ECS Fargate infra
aws_evidence: Founding Engineer job posting lists deployment on AWS (ECS Fargate) alongside Python/FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Docker, LiveKit, Twilio (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/effigov/jobs/c37ANEq-founding-engineer)
pitch_note: Best-fit lead in this slice: explicitly AWS-native (ECS Fargate in the founding-engineer JD), sells 24/7 AI phone lines to city governments handling resident PII, has zero published compliance posture, and is hiring its first engineer -- government RFPs will force a SOC 2 Type I almost immediately. Only caveat is pre-seed budget (~$500K).

name: TwentyTwo

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 information found; company was acquired by LatchBio to form Latch Biosecurity, so it is no longer an independent buyer

pitch_note: Dead lead: TwentyTwo was acquired by LatchBio and folded into Latch Biosecurity, so there is no independent 3-person startup left to sell a SOC 2 engagement to. Any compliance buying decision now sits with LatchBio.

name: Perspectives Health

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 badge, trust page, or compliance claim found on site or job posts
Product writes clinical documentation and audits charts for behavioral health clinics -- handles PHI, so clinic and payer vendor reviews will demand SOC 2 + HIPAA

pitch_note: PHI-touching AI for behavioral health clinics (chart audits, clinical documentation) with ~$1.6M raised, $250K cARR in 4 weeks, a senior engineering hire open, and no published SOC 2/HIPAA posture -- clinic groups and payers will require SOC 2 Type I as deals grow. Classic pre-compliance seed-stage healthtech.

name: Veritus

soc2_evidence.signal: Funding coverage states Veritus is 'PCI compliant for handling payments, HIPAA compliant, ISO certified, and SOC Type II compliant'

hiring_signals: YC profile marked is_hiring; team of 10 scaling after $10.1M seed
pitch_note: Disqualified: Veritus already advertises SOC 2 Type II plus PCI, HIPAA, and ISO in its $10.1M seed press -- compliance stack is done and their round exceeds the <$10M ICP threshold. Only angle would be ongoing audit/renewal support.
